done.why: The troll was dead and the passages east and west were unfinished, so the reachable world seemed used up for now.

about: A compact Zork-style start: the white house, kitchen, living room, trap door, cellar and troll room, with the underground just beginning.

moments.note: Unusual phrasings like knock on door were not recognized.
Trap door crashed shut behind me on descent.
Troll disarmed by a feint, then killed in a few swings.
Unfinished passage with a note from The Management.
Pick mentioned in text but cannot be taken.

wished: Take the pick that the text mentions.
Compound commands like take lantern and sword.
Go west into the forbidding hole.

lines.line: The passage to the east has not been finished. Someone has left a pick leaning against the rock, and a note: "Back soon. -- The Management."
lines.why: Witty way to block an unbuilt area.

lines.line: The troll is disarmed by a subtle feint past his guard.

engagement.why: Pulled along until the dead ends.

interestingness.why: Known layout, with a few playful touches.
